fields.description: Zone the record is published in; the host is relative to it. Defaults to the default zone for records created by hand.
fields.label: DNS Zone

fields.description: Name relative to the zone, e.g. n1.blr for n1.blr.frappemail.com. Use @ for the zone itself.
fields.label: Host

fields.description: A and AAAA carry IP addresses, MX a mail server name with a priority, TXT free text such as SPF, CNAME an alias.
fields.label: Type

fields.description: What the record is for. Node: a server's own hostname. Ingress: the cluster hostname's round-robin entry. Egress: gateway, pool and EHLO hostnames. SPF: the include target customer domains reference. Platform: the platform domain's own MX, DKIM, DMARC and TLS-RPT. Service: a single-machine service reached by name, such as the SFU. Other: created by hand.
fields.label: Category
fields.options:
Node
Ingress
Egress
SPF
Platform
Service
Other

fields.description: The record's content: an IP address, a hostname for MX and CNAME, or the text for TXT. Several records may share host and type with different values (round-robin). Pushed to the zone's provider on save.
fields.label: Value

fields.description: MX only: lower numbers are tried first.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: Seconds resolvers may cache the record. Blank uses the zone's default TTL, then the one in Mail Settings. Changing it updates the provider.
fields.label: TTL

fields.description: The record resolves at public resolvers with this exact value. Set when the zone's provider confirms it, by Verify DNS Record and by the daily check. If the zone has no provider, add the record by hand and verify.
fields.label: Verified

fields.description: When the record was last pushed to the provider or verified.
fields.label: Last Checked At

fields.description: Records owned by a cluster, node, gateway or pool are created and removed with it. Blank means created by hand.
fields.label: Managed By Type

fields.description: The document that owns this record. Deleting the record here only lasts until that document is saved again.
fields.label: Managed By
